subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the text evidence that supports the idea.

items.prompt:
Idea: 'The dog was loyal.'
Text: 'It waited at the station every evening for its owner.'
The evidence is:
A) It waited at the station every evening
B) The dog is an animal
C) Stations are busy
items.answer: A) It waited at the station every evening

solution.answer: A) It waited at the station every evening

items.prompt:
A detail from a text that proves your point is:
A) evidence
B) a title
C) a guess

To write about a text, your ideas should be supported by:
A) evidence from the text
B) your lunch
C) the weather

steps: Use text evidence. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Idea: 'Nadia is determined.'
Which detail BEST proves it?
A) Though exhausted, she rowed through the night to rescue the hikers.
B) Nadia has a boat.
C) It was dark.
items.answer: A) Though exhausted, she rowed through the night to rescue the hikers.

solution.answer: A) Though exhausted, she rowed through the night to rescue the hikers.

items.prompt:
For an informational text, the BEST evidence is usually:
A) a fact, statistic, or reason from the text
B) a made-up story
C) a personal wish
items.answer: A) a fact, statistic, or reason from the text

steps: Facts are evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a fact, statistic, or reason from the text

items.prompt:
Idea: 'The king was unjust.'
Which detail proves it?
A) He wore a golden crown.
B) He taxed the poor heavily while sparing the rich.
C) He lived in a castle.
items.answer: B) He taxed the poor heavily while sparing the rich.

solution.answer: B) He taxed the poor heavily while sparing the rich.

items.prompt:
Read.

The article claims reading daily builds vocabulary, citing a study where daily readers learned 50% more words.

Which is the EVIDENCE for the claim?
A) reading daily builds vocabulary
B) a study where daily readers learned 50% more words
C) reading is fun
items.answer: B) a study where daily readers learned 50% more words

steps: The study is the evidence. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) a study where daily readers learned 50% more words

items.prompt:
Why include EVIDENCE when writing an analysis of a text?
A) It proves your interpretation and makes it convincing
B) It makes the paper longer only
C) It hides your idea
items.answer: A) It proves your interpretation and makes it convincing

steps: Evidence supports analysis. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) It proves your interpretation and makes it convincing
